body.message:
Please find the monthly rates below, based on a stay of 30 nights per month:

July: AED 12,500
August: AED 12,500

A refundable security deposit of AED 3,000 is also required.

Please note that the AED 11,000 rate you previously saw was applicable for June only.

As rates vary depending on the month and market conditions, the current rate for July and August is AED 12,500 per month.
